edges.reason: Fallback function performs an internal call to buy().
buy() takes msg.sender as the investor address.
buy() assigns msg.value to the local payment variable.
payment is multiplied by the ETH price to derive the token amount.
m_ETHPriceInCents feeds the token amount arithmetic.
Arithmetic result is stored in tokenAmount.
buy() reads m_currentTokensSold for tier selection and cap computation.
buy() uses c_centsPerTokenFirst for the first tier.
buy() uses c_centsPerTokenSecond for the second tier.
buy() reads c_priceRiseTokenAmount as the tier boundary.
buy() reads c_maximumTokensSold as the hard cap.
tokenAmount is compared against maxTokensAllowed.
ethPerToken recomputes the effective payment when capping the purchase.
m_currentTokensSold is increased by tokenAmount using SafeMath add.
buy() sends ether to m_beneficiary via external transfer before the transaction completes.
m_beneficiary is the recipient of the external ether transfer.
buy() performs an external token transfer to the investor.
m_token is the external token contract being called.
buy() refunds leftover change via an external transfer to the investor.
The local change value is forwarded to the investor.
change is computed as msg.value - payment through SafeMath sub.
buy() enforces the minimum investment c_MinInvestmentInCents.
buy() requires !priceExpired() to enforce the sale pause.
getTime() returns now, i.e. block.timestamp.
priceExpired() relies on block.timestamp.
updateRequestExpired() relies on block.timestamp.
priceExpired() reads m_ETHPriceLastUpdate.
priceExpired() reads m_ETHPriceUpdateInterval.
updateRequestExpired() reads m_ETHPriceLastUpdateRequest.
updateRequestExpired() adds m_leeway to offset timestamp inaccuracy.
updateETHPriceInCents() is gated by updateRequestExpired().
__callback() authenticates msg.sender against the Oraclize callback address.
__callback() uses oraclize_cbAddress() for the sender check.
oraclize_cbAddress() reads the resolved oraclize contract.
The oraclize instance is resolved through the OAR registry.
The Oraclize result string is converted by parseInt.
The parsed price is stored in the newPrice local.
__callback writes the validated price into m_ETHPriceInCents.
__callback checks the lower bound before accepting the price.
__callback checks the upper bound before accepting the price.
__callback refreshes m_ETHPriceLastUpdate via getTime().
__callback recursively calls updateETHPriceInCents(), allowing callback-triggered re-query and re-entry cycles.
updateETHPriceInCents() calls the internal oraclize_query helper.
updateETHPriceInCents() triggers a payable external Oraclize query.
oraclize_query performs the value-bearing external call to Oraclize.
oraclize_getPrice performs an external call to oraclize.getPrice.
updateETHPriceInCents() prices the query through oraclize_getPrice.
m_callbackGas is passed as the gas limit to the Oraclize query.
m_ETHPriceUpdateInterval is used as the query delay.
updateETHPriceInCents() records m_ETHPriceLastUpdateRequest.
setETHPriceUpperBound writes m_ETHPriceUpperBound behind onlymanyowners.
setETHPriceLowerBound writes m_ETHPriceLowerBound behind onlymanyowners.
setETHPriceManually writes m_ETHPriceInCents behind onlymanyowners.
setETHPriceManually refreshes m_ETHPriceLastUpdate.
setOraclizeGasPrice forwards to oraclize_setCustomGasPrice.
setOraclizeGasLimit writes m_callbackGas behind onlymanyowners.
finishSale requires m_nextSale to be set.
finishSale disables the sale by setting m_active to false.
finishSale forwards the whole ether balance to the external next sale contract.
finishSale transfers the remaining token balance to the next sale via an external token call.
finishSale calls the external m_token.switchToNextSale.
The remaining token balance is read from m_token.
setNextSale writes m_nextSale behind onlymanyowners.
The multiowned constructor fills the m_owners array.
The multiowned constructor fills the m_ownerIndex mapping.
The multiowned constructor sets m_numOwners.
The multiowned constructor sets m_multiOwnedRequired.
confirmAndCheck reads msg.sender to determine the confirmation bitmap.
confirmAndCheck derives the caller bitmap through makeOwnerBitmapBit.
makeOwnerBitmapBit reads m_ownerIndex for the given sender.
confirmAndCheck reads and writes m_multiOwnedPending.
confirmAndCheck appends the operation to m_multiOwnedPendingIndex.
confirmAndCheck resets pending.yetNeeded from m_multiOwnedRequired.
isOperationActive reads the yetNeeded field of m_multiOwnedPending.
assertOperationIsConsistent inspects m_multiOwnedPending invariants.
changeOwner is gated by onlymanyowners which calls confirmAndCheck.
addOwner is gated by onlymanyowners which calls confirmAndCheck.
removeOwner is gated by onlymanyowners which calls confirmAndCheck.
changeRequirement is gated by onlymanyowners which calls confirmAndCheck.
changeOwner rewrites m_ownerIndex entries.
changeOwner rewrites m_owners entries.
addOwner increments m_numOwners.
removeOwner computes m_numOwners - 1 for validation and pruning.
removeOwner calls reorganizeOwners after deletion.
changeRequirement writes m_multiOwnedRequired.
revoke reads msg.sender and requires the caller to be an owner.
revoke decrements the pending confirmation counters.
hasConfirmed reads the ownersDone bitmap of m_multiOwnedPending.
isOwner reads the m_ownerIndex mapping to authorize callers.
clearPending deletes all pending operation states.
clearPending deletes m_multiOwnedPendingIndex.
reorganizeOwners compacts the m_owners array.
reorganizeOwners updates m_ownerIndex after swaps.
getOwners reads m_owners and m_numOwners.
BoomstarterPresale constructor invokes the EthPriceDependent constructor.
BoomstarterPresale constructor invokes the multiowned constructor.
Constructor stores the token interface in m_token.
Constructor stores the beneficiary in m_beneficiary.
Constructor activates the sale.
EthPriceDependent constructor sets the Oraclize proof type.
EthPriceDependent constructor triggers the first price update on production.
Constructor sets the OAR resolver address when not in production.
oraclize_newRandomDSQuery issues an external random query through oraclize_query.
proofVerify__main validates ledger signatures through ecrecover-based checks.
ecrecovery delegates to safer_ecrecover after range checks.
safer_ecrecover performs a raw assembly CALL to the ecrecover precompile.
proofVerify__main slices proof buffers with copyBytes.
copyBytes uses inline assembly memory copy operations.
proofVerify__main verifies signatures via verifySig.
verifySig calls safer_ecrecover for both v values.
parseInt converts the untrusted Oraclize string into a uint price.

normalization_plan.reason: Local investor is only the msg.sender alias used inside buy().
Local payment tracks msg.value inside buy().
tokenAmount is the direct result of the price conversion arithmetic.
cap only selects the tier maximum inside buy().
centsPerToken only stores the selected tier price inside buy().
maxTokensAllowed is a cap comparison helper local to buy().
ethPerToken is produced by the same price/token arithmetic used in buy().
change is the exact value forwarded by the refund transfer.
newPrice exists only inside __callback to hold the parsed price.
price local holds oraclize_getPrice output inside oraclize_query.
args is the CBOR buffer built inside oraclize_query.
Bound/price parameter consumed by the price bound setter family.
Address parameter written to m_nextSale by setNextSale.
Owner list parameter consumed by the multiowned constructor.
Confirmation count parameter consumed by the multiowned constructor.
Operation hash parameter drives confirmAndCheck state transitions.
Loop owner variable only exists during constructor initialization.
ownerIndex local is derived inside owner removal bookkeeping.
free cursor only exists inside the owner compaction loop.
length local only exists to bound the clearPending deletion loop.
mint accumulator only exists inside the parseInt loop.
decimals flag only exists inside the parseInt loop.
Oraclize result string parameter is consumed by __callback.
Query id parameter is unused state input of __callback.
Delay parameter is consumed by the random DS query builder.
Byte-count parameter bounds the random DS query builder.
Gas price parameter flows to oraclize_setCustomGasPrice through its setter.
Gas parameter is written into m_callbackGas by setOraclizeGasLimit.
Recovery id local is extracted inside ecrecovery before ecrecover.
Signature bytes parameter is consumed by the signature verification routine.
Public key parameter is hashed and compared inside verifySig.
